hintsEn.USA: Disney Magic (83,969 GT), Disney Fantasy (129,690 GT), Disney Wish (144,256 GT), Disney Treasure (144,256 GT), Disney Destiny (144,256 GT)

noValue.BHS: 8 艘全部登記在拿索（船籍），但不是母港；私人島 Castaway Cay、Lookout Cay 也在巴哈馬
noValue.JPN: Disney Imagination 預定 2029 年以東京為母港（東方樂園公司擁有與營運）
noValue.TWN: 迪士尼郵輪沒有以台灣為母港，英文維基的條目裡也沒有停靠台灣的港口；亞洲唯一的常駐母港是新加坡（2026 年 3 月起）

noValueEn.BHS: All 8 ships are registered in Nassau (flag) but none is based there; the private islands Castaway Cay and Lookout Cay are also in the Bahamas
noValueEn.JPN: Disney Imagination is due to be based in Tokyo from 2029 (owned and operated by Oriental Land)
noValueEn.TWN: No Disney ship is based in Taiwan, and the Wikipedia article lists no Taiwanese port; the only Asian base is Singapore (from March 2026)
